convert_mjcf_to_urdf: run the mjcf2urdf script to convert a MuJoCo XML file to a ROS URDF file
load_mjcf_with_bulletclient: create a BulletClient and load a MuJoCo MJCF XML file using loadMJCF with implicit cylinder flags
initialize_urdf_editor_from_bullet_body: initialize a UrdfEditor from a loaded PyBullet body using initializeFromBulletBody
save_urdf_from_editor: save a URDF file to disk using the UrdfEditor saveUrdf method with optional visual geometry
get_body_info_from_bullet: get the robot name and part name from a loaded PyBullet body using getBodyInfo
